articles.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
articles.description: Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー、ハーラル国王を追悼、ホーコン8世が即位
articles.summary: ノルウェー国民はハーラル国王の逝去を悼み、王宮前には多くの弔問客が集まった。息子のホーコン8世が即位し、家族のモットーを受け継ぐ。

articles.title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
articles.description: Anne Lindboe, the mayor of Norway's capital, had planned to marry her fiance on Friday.
articles.titleJa: ノルウェー国王崩御を受け、オスロ市長が結婚式を中止
articles.summary: ノルウェー国王の逝去を受け、首都オスロの市長は金曜日に予定されていた自身の結婚式を取りやめた。

articles.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
articles.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.
articles.titleJa: ロシアはレトリックを強めるも、NATOとの戦争は回避したいと西側当局者が指摘
articles.summary: 西側当局者は、ロシアがNATO加盟国に対する「ハイブリッド活動」を続ける可能性が高いものの、直接的な軍事行動は避ける意向だと述べた。

articles.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
articles.description: The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.
articles.titleJa: 右翼コメンテーターのミロ・ヤノプルス氏がICEに拘束される
articles.summary: 米国在住で活動する英国人右翼コメンテーター、ミロ・ヤノプルス氏が移民関税執行局（ICE）に拘束された。彼は過去にトランプ大統領とICEを支持していた。

articles.title: Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight
articles.description: Police are hunting two suspects they believe bought a ticket for the exhibition to get at the jewellery.
articles.titleJa: ウィーンの博物館で白昼、600個のダイヤモンドネックレスが盗まれる
articles.summary: ウィーンの博物館で白昼、600個のダイヤモンドネックレスが盗難に遭った。警察は、展示会のチケットを購入して宝飾品に近づいたとされる容疑者2人を追っている。

articles.title: Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final
articles.description: Experts examined the use of forced contraception on the Inuit community during the 1960s and 70s.
articles.titleJa: グリーンランド、ジェノサイド疑惑に関する調査結果は最終ではないと発表
articles.summary: グリーンランド政府は、1960年代から70年代にかけてイヌイット社会に行われた強制避妊に関するジェノサイド疑惑の調査結果は、まだ最終ではないと発表した。

articles.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
articles.description: A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.
articles.titleJa: 移民危機続くセウタで暴力勃発
articles.summary: 移民危機が続くスペイン領セウタで暴力が発生。移民グループが軍用車両に投石し、一部住民が浜辺のキャンプに火を放った。

articles.title: World's youngest reigning traditional monarch dies aged 34
articles.description: King Oyo ascended to the throne of Uganda's Tooro kingdom when he was just three years old.
articles.titleJa: 世界最年少の伝統的な現役君主が34歳で死去
articles.summary: ウガンダのトーロ王国の国王、オヨ氏が34歳で死去した。彼はわずか3歳で王位に就いた世界最年少の現役伝統君主だった。

articles.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
articles.description: Canada has rejected the new name of the lake, which straddles both countries, as their row deepens.
articles.titleJa: トランプ大統領、オンタリオ湖を「アメリカ湖」に改名する命令に署名
articles.summary: トランプ大統領がオンタリオ湖を「アメリカ湖」に改名する命令に署名した。両国にまたがる湖の新名称をカナダは拒否し、両国の対立が深まっている。

articles.title: Two-year curfew lifted in Sudan's capital
articles.description: The military authorities retook control of the city 18 months ago, but the conflict continues elsewhere.
articles.titleJa: スーダン首都で2年間の夜間外出禁止令が解除
articles.summary: スーダンの首都で2年間にわたる夜間外出禁止令が解除された。軍当局は18か月前に市を奪還したが、紛争は他の地域で続いている。

articles.title: Austria museum heist: Thieves snatch diamond necklace
articles.description: The stolen necklace, studded with 673 precious stones, belonged to Egypt's Queen Nazli. It was being displayed as part of the museum's exhibition for designs by France's Van Cleef and Arpels.
articles.titleJa: オーストリアの美術館で窃盗：泥棒がダイヤモンドのネックレスを強奪
articles.summary: オーストリアの美術館で、エジプトのナズリ女王のダイヤモンドネックレスが盗難。673個の宝石が飾られた貴重な品で、企画展中に被害に遭った。

articles.title: Germany news: Baltic summit plans hybrid-threat task force
articles.description: Ministers from countries bordering the Baltic Sea have agreed on a rapid response force to counter hybrid threats. Meanwhile, the far-right AfD has failed to topple a state premier. DW has more updates from Germany.
articles.titleJa: ドイツのニュース：バルト海サミットでハイブリッド脅威対策部隊を計画
articles.summary: バルト海諸国の閣僚がハイブリッド脅威対策の迅速対応部隊を設置することで合意。一方、ドイツでは極右AfDによる州首相転覆は失敗に終わった。

articles.title: What next? Kurds say yes, Druze still say no to united Syria
articles.description: The Druze minority in Sweida, Syria, is now the only group that hasn't accepted central government authority. How does the end of an independent Kurdish area impact Druze plans for a different, divided kind of Syria?
articles.titleJa: 次に何が？クルド人は賛成、ドルーズ派は統一シリアに依然反対
articles.summary: シリアのスワイダに住むドルーズ派は中央政府の権威を唯一受け入れていない。クルド人自治区の終焉が、ドルーズ派が目指す「異なる分割されたシリア」の計画にどう影響するか。

articles.title: Germany: Man gets life in jail for US tourist's rape, murder
articles.description: The crime was unsolved for over three decades before new DNA proof made it possible to arrest and convict the now 81-year-old. His victim, Amy Lopez, was 24 at the time of her murder.
articles.titleJa: ドイツ：米国人観光客のレイプ・殺害で男に終身刑
articles.summary: 30年以上未解決だったドイツでの米国人観光客のレイプ・殺害事件で、新たなDNA証拠により81歳の男が逮捕・有罪となり、終身刑を言い渡された。

articles.title: Uganda: World's 'youngest monarch' dies aged 34
articles.description: Oyo Nyimba, once recognized as the world's youngest reigning monarch, has died in his mid-30s. As one of Uganda's traditional monarchs, he took the throne of the Tooro kingdom in 1995, aged just 3.
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ：世界「最年少君主」が34歳で死去
articles.summary: かつて世界最年少の君主とされたウガンダのオヨ・ニインバ国王が30代半ばで死去。3歳でトーロ王国を継承し、伝統君主の一人として知られた。

articles.title: Africa's aging autocrats fight to stay in power
articles.description: As some of Africa's longest-serving leaders grow older, they are using different tactics to extend their rule. But age, succession battles and public pressure pose new challenges.
articles.titleJa: アフリカの高齢独裁者たちが権力維持に奮闘
articles.summary: アフリカで長期政権を握る指導者たちが高齢化に伴い、様々な手段で権力維持を図っている。しかし、年齢、後継者争い、国民の圧力などが新たな課題となっている。

articles.title: Germany's grape harvest starts earlier than ever
articles.description: Growers expect good quality but below-average yields following an exceptionally hot summer. It continues a decades-long shift toward earlier picking.
articles.titleJa: ドイツのブドウ収穫が史上最速で始まる
articles.summary: 異例の猛暑により、ドイツのブドウ収穫が例年より早く始まった。生産者は高品質を期待するも、収穫量は平均を下回ると予想されており、早期収穫の傾向が続いている。

articles.title: What 'The Odyssey' can teach us about climate chaos
articles.description: The Bronze Age collapse may have started with a water crisis. Today’s droughts raise the unsettling question of whether it could happen again.
articles.titleJa: 『オデュッセイア』が気候変動の混乱について教えてくれること
articles.summary: 青銅器時代の崩壊は水危機に始まった可能性があり、今日の干ばつは同様の事態が再び起こりうるかという不穏な問いを投げかけている。

articles.title: Serbia: Keeping EU, Russia in play ahead of key election
articles.description: As Serbia heads towards an uncertain election, President Aleksandar Vucic is balancing ties with Russia and EU ambitions. But growing geopolitical tensions and pressure at home are narrowing his room to maneuver.
articles.titleJa: セルビア：重要な選挙を前にEUとロシアのカードを維持
articles.summary: 不確実な選挙を控えるセルビアのブチッチ大統領は、ロシアとの関係とEU加盟への野望を両立させようとしている。地政学的緊張と国内圧力で選択肢は狭まっている。

articles.title: Rwanda genocide: Dutch court sentences man to life in prison
articles.description: The Rwandan-born Dutch national was found guilty of involvement in the massacre of around 3,000 Tutsis, including throwing a grenade into a crowd of people sheltering in a football stadium.
articles.titleJa: ルワンダ虐殺：オランダの裁判所が男に終身刑を宣告
articles.summary: ルワンダ生まれのオランダ国籍の男が、約3,000人のツチ族虐殺に関与した罪で有罪となり、終身刑を言い渡された。スタジアムで避難中の人々に手榴弾を投げ込んだとされる。

articles.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
articles.description:
Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hours
Austrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty.
Authorities in the capital released pictures of the suspects captured by security cameras during the heist at the Museum of Applied Arts (MAK), amid a rash of spectacular smash-and-grab thefts from European cultural institutions.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エジプト女王の673個のダイヤモンドネックレス、ウィーンで強奪される
articles.summary: ウィーンの博物館から、かつてエジプト王族が所有していた673個のダイヤモンドネックレスが強奪された。警察は容疑者2人を追跡中。

articles.title: What could Meta’s US settlement mean around the world – and what now for other claims against firm?
articles.description:
Other governments could seek similar concessions, while separate legal action is pending in places ranging from Kenya to the Netherlands
In October 2021, Abrham Meareg’s father, a professor of chemistry in Ethiopia’s northern town of Bahir Dar, was shot at close range and died outside his family home. This was in the middle of the country’s civil war.
For weeks, Facebook’s algorithm had actively promoted posts calling for the academic to be murdered, according to Meareg and Foxglove, a nonprofit organisation supporting Meareg’s lawsuit against the company in Kenya. These posts included photos of his father and his home address.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: Meta社の米国での和解が世界に何をもたらすか、そして同社に対する他の訴訟の行方は？
articles.summary: Meta社の米国での和解が世界に与える影響と、ケニアやオランダなど他の国で係争中の訴訟について論じている。エチオピアでの公民権侵害に関連する訴訟も取り上げられた。

articles.title: UK urged to help free British-Egyptian ‘arrested in Cairo over sister’s activism’
articles.description:
Lawyers claim Eman el-Shazly, from Birmingham, was detained in effort to silence her sister, a critic of Sisi regime
The UK Foreign Office has been asked to intervene to secure the release of a British-Egyptian woman who it is claimed has been arrested in Cairo because of her sister’s political activism.
Eman el-Shazly, a 45-year-old based in Birmingham, was arrested on 16 August while visiting Egypt. Her lawyers say she has been detained in an attempt to silence her sister Mona, a relentless and harsh critic of the Egyptian government on her UK-based YouTube channel.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 英国、姉の活動を理由にカイロで逮捕された英エジプト人女性の釈放を支援するよう要請される
articles.summary: 英国籍を持つエジプト人女性がカイロで逮捕された。姉がエジプト政府を批判する活動家であるためとされ、英国外務省に釈放に向けた介入が要請されている。

articles.title: South African police arrest two Thai men for allegedly smuggling parrot eggs
articles.description:
Bird eggs intercepted in homemade incubators at Johannesburg airport as officials try to halt wildlife trafficking
South African police have arrested two Thai nationals in separate incidents for allegedly attempting to smuggle endangered parrot eggs out of the country as authorities try to stem the tide of wildlife trafficking.
A 50-year-old Thai national was arrested at OR Tambo international airport in Johannesburg on 20 August, carrying 50 bird eggs in a homemade incubator in a hand-luggage bag, South Africa’s environment ministry said in a statement.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカ警察、オウムの卵密輸容疑でタイ人男性2人を逮捕
articles.summary: 南アフリカの警察が、ヨハネスブルグの空港で絶滅危惧種のオウムの卵を密輸しようとした疑いでタイ人2人を逮捕した。野生生物密輸阻止の取り組みの一環。

articles.title: Mpox is back – and in new countries. How can this outbreak be contained?
articles.description:
The public health emergencies in 2022 and 2024 saw the virus reported in 145 countries, but in the new cases children appear particularly affected
A fresh outbreak of mpox in Guinea Bissau – the country’s first – means the virus formerly known as monkey pox is back in the headlines. So what has changed?
Since 2022, there have been almost 190,000 lab-confirmed cases of mpox reported worldwide in 145 countries. Before then, outbreaks of mpox tended to be relatively small and in a handful of African countries, where the viral infection was known to be endemic.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: エムポックスが再燃し、新たな国々で発生。このアウトブレイクはどう封じ込められるか？
articles.summary: ギニアビサウでエムポックスの新たなアウトブレイクが発生。2022年以降、世界145カ国で約19万件の症例が確認されており、今回は特に子供に影響が見られる。

articles.title: Venezuelan opposition up in arms over reports US wants big stake in oil and gas
articles.description:
Critics call move to gain long-term access to country’s massive energy reserves  ‘predatory’ and ‘unconstitutional’
Reports that the US is preparing to claim a big stake in Venezuela’s massive energy reserves have sparked an outcry, with critics describing the move as “predatory” and a “rapacious” land grab.
Several media outlets this week reported that the Trump administration – which abducted Venezuela’s authoritarian president, Nicolás Maduro, in January and has steered the South American country ever since – hopes to secure long-term access to its oil and gasfields.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国が石油・ガスに巨額の権益を望むとの報道に、ベネズエラ野党が激怒
articles.summary: 米国がベネズエラの広大なエネルギー資源に大きな権益を求めているとの報道に対し、ベネズエラ野党は「略奪的」「憲法違反」と強く反発している。

articles.title: Tropical Storm Dolly downgraded to ‘open tropical wave’ as it heads to Caribbean
articles.description:
Remnants from tropical storm could cause heavy rainfall on Leeward Islands and affect Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico and Hispaniola
Remnants of Tropical Storm Dolly, which has been downgraded to an “open tropical wave”, were moving still across the Atlantic Ocean toward the Leeward Islands, and could bring heavy rainfall to parts of the Caribbean this weekend, the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said on Friday..
Dolly, which formed on Thursday, had maximum sustained winds of near 40mph (65km/h) with higher gusts on Friday morning. Later on Friday, forecasters said that Dolly was no longer a Tropical Storm, and had “become an open tropical wave”.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 熱帯低気圧ドリー、カリブ海へ向かい「開放熱帯波」に格下げ
articles.summary: 熱帯低気圧ドリーが「開放熱帯波」に格下げされ、大西洋をカリブ海のリーワード諸島に向かって移動中。週末にはこの地域の広範囲で大雨をもたらす可能性がある。

articles.title: Detroit despairs as ‘insanity’ of Trump’s Canada trade war punishes city
articles.description:
Unpopular new policy comes as midterms loom and control of Congress could be decided by several Michigan races
Every day $1bn worth of goods crosses the river dividing Detroit, Michigan, and Windsor, Ontario, two largely blue-collar US and Canadian cities that have come to act as one in the creation of North America’s auto industry.
News this week of Donald Trump’s escalating trade spat with Canada has everyone worried. Political and economic leaders and observers labeled the move an act of “hubris” , blamed Trump’s “ego”, and called the escalation “insanity”.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプのカナダとの貿易戦争がデトロイトを苦しめ、「狂気」に絶望
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプ大統領のカナダとの貿易戦争が激化し、デトロイトの経済に深刻な影響を与えている。ミシガン州の選挙戦にも影響が出ると予想される。

articles.title: Trump signs executive order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
articles.description:
Mark Carney rejects attempt to rename lake as did several US governors, with Tony Evers mocking the move

US politics live – latest updates

Donald Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario, making it Lake America, amid his escalating trade war with Canada.
The order directs federal agencies to adopt the name-change on US maps, documents and databases. But Trump has no authority to rename Canada’s portion of the lake, nor to compel Canada, international legal bodies, international mapmakers or the rest of the world to adopt a new name.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ大統領、オンタリオ湖を「アメリカ湖」に改名する大統領令に署名
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプ大統領が、カナダとの貿易戦争激化の中、オンタリオ湖を「アメリカ湖」に改名する大統領令に署名した。カナダ側や国際社会への影響は限定的とみられる。

articles.title: How to lose Trump’s trade war: test Canada’s resolve with threats to hockey sticks
articles.description:
The US president expected Ottawa to bow to tariff demands, but Canada is striking back – and it could cost Americans

This was originally published in This Week in Trumpland. Sign up to receive it in your inbox every Wednesday

Earlier this year, a survey found that Canada, along with Switzerland, was the best-liked country in the world. We all know this kind of polling is about as scientific as a high school popularity contest, but at least anecdotally, Canadians have a reputation for being friendly and welcoming, respectful and polite. Many people would find it difficult to dislike Canadians.
But not Donald Trump, who in a “hold my beer” moment this week demonstrated that he, at least, finds it easy to resent Canadians. The US president called the country “difficult and unreasonable”, and in a particularly hysterical moment, threatened to rename a lake, after trade talks collapsed.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ貿易戦争に敗れる方法：ホッケースティックへの脅威でカナダの決意を試す
articles.summary: トランプ大統領がカナダに仕掛けた貿易戦争が、ホッケースティックへの関税という脅威でカナダの反発を招き、米国にとって不利な結果を招く可能性があると分析されている。

articles.title: Europe's royal houses and world leaders mourn the death of Norway's King Harald V
articles.description: Europe's oldest reigning monarch, King Harald had been in hospital in Oslo since 17 August, suffering from haemolytic anaemia, a condition caused by an abnormally rapid destruction of red blood cells.

articles.description: Rescuers were battling through mud even as the threat of new floods loomed, with emergency teams recovering 586 bodies so far and some of the dead swept downstream as far away as India.

articles.summary: ネパールでの洪水により行方不明者が2,400人を超え、ユニセフは17,000人の子供たちが援助を必要としていると発表。救助隊は泥と戦い、586人の遺体を発見した。

articles.title: Ceuta warns it is 'on the brink of collapse' as Spain seeks Frontex and Europol help

articles.title: Bayeux Tapestry: Macron to open landmark London exhibition next Wednesday

articles.summary: グリーンランドが、1960年代から90年代にかけて4,000人以上のイヌイット女性に同意なく強制避妊を行った問題について、真実調査委員会を設置する。

articles.title: Céline Dion concerts: Canadian star returns to Paris after six years away from the stage
articles.description: The Quebec singer arrived in Paris on Friday, 28 August, for a run of 16 concerts in the French capital.

articles.summary: カナダ出身の歌手セリーヌ・ディオンが、6年間の休止期間を経て、8月28日にパリに到着し、フランスの首都で16回のコンサートを行う。

articles.title: Fans welcome Céline Dion outside her Paris hotel as she prepares to launch a 16‑show arena residency
